# NJ.com Autos

> > NJ.com's automotive marketplace connecting New Jersey car buyers with millions of new and used vehicle listings across the state.

NJ.com Autos serves the New Jersey market with comprehensive vehicle search capabilities, featuring over 5 million listings from both dealers and private sellers. The platform focuses on local inventory with location-based search centered around major cities like Newark.
